title: God Has Answers
verse: Moses answered again, “And if they do not believe me or pay attention to me, but say, ‘The Lord has not appeared to you’?” The Lord said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A staff.
observation: Moses had so many questions. It is impossible to tell if he had innocent questions or if he thought he could somehow convince God that there were too many reasons to choose someone else. However, for every question, the LORD had an answer. Just like Moses, we will often have many questions about our life, our calling, our future, and more. If we are willing to seek the LORD, He will provide the answers we need. This does not mean He will give us the answers we want. Moses asked what to do if the people did not believe him. God responded, but not in a way Moses may have expected. The same goes for us. We must be careful not to preload our expected answers. Ask God, then study His Word. Let the truth of God’s Word lead us wherever it will.
application: Don’t just let questions linger. Take them to God by studying His Word and watch what He does.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being willing to give answers to all our endless questions.
